summary: Full frontend E2E of KantinSMK Go (Laravel 12 + Livewire 3). All 12 priority flows exercised through the browser: role-based login/redirects, role guards, DB-backed cart persistence across sessions, split cart across 2 tenants, checkout with QRIS/Transfer/Cash payment states, tenant admin verify-transfer + verify-payment (cash), tenant order board isolation, admin-provisioned onboarding via one-time activation link (fresh browser), invalid/expired token page, notifications bell + mark-all, and settlements (tenant + platform admin). Core functionality is working. One infra bug found and self-fixed (stale compiled Blade view for tenant/payments). One real UX/robustness issue with login rate-limit + stale-CSRF handling that main agent should look at.

minor.issue: Route uses throttle:5,1 which fires quickly during real usage (agent had to sleep 60s to recover). Combined with stale CSRF from previous browser session, form silently redirects back to /login with no visible error/toast. Recommend surfacing throttle/CSRF error to user OR raising the limit for logged-out login attempts.
Returns 405 (POST-only). Correct security, but no visible logout link on catalog pages for buyer — must go to /akun. Acceptable but worth documenting.

ui_bugs.issue: Spec references data-testid 'cart-tenant-group-{id}' but the implementation uses 'cart-group-{id}'. Functionally identical, but automation/spec drift.

At test start the compiled Blade view crashed with 'syntax error, unexpected token "endif"' (View: .../tenant/payments.blade.php). Source file is syntactically fine — the compiled cache was stale/corrupted. Ran `php artisan view:clear` and it recovered. Add a deploy step that clears view cache or investigate what left a corrupt compiled view.

integration_issues.flow: Login (re-login while old session cookie exists)
integration_issues.issue: If the browser still holds a session cookie from a prior context, POST /login silently returns back to /login without displaying any error. Clearing cookies works around it. Users refreshing after long idle may experience 'Masuk button does nothing'.

issues: Tailwind CDN warning in console: 'cdn.tailwindcss.com should not be used in production'. Ship a compiled CSS build before go-live.

action_items: Investigate why POST /login silently redirects back with no flash/error when CSRF is stale or throttle triggers; surface a clear message.
Ensure `php artisan view:clear` runs on deploy (or fix the source of the corrupted compiled view for tenant/payments.blade.php).
Replace Tailwind CDN with a compiled build before production.
Align spec vs implementation for cart-group testid (either rename to `cart-tenant-group-{id}` or update the spec).
critical_code_review_comments: throttle:5,1 on login is aggressive for a school marketplace and combined with server-rendered form gives poor UX. Consider throttle:10,1 or per-IP-per-email.
Login controller returns `back()->withErrors(...)` — verify the Blade actually renders $errors on /login (screenshots showed no visible error text when auth failed).
Compiled views cache appears to have gone stale after code changes; add `view:clear` to CI/deploy or use `php artisan optimize` on release.
Admin user role select uses a specific value list — expose values via testid or aria attributes to help automated testing.

success_rate.frontend: ≈95% (11 of 12 priority flows fully passing; login-robustness caveat)

rca of the issue: Login-redirect-to-self bug: Playwright automation reuses browser contexts across separate tool calls, so a previously issued session cookie & CSRF token persists. When form is re-submitted with a stale token, Laravel's VerifyCsrfToken middleware redirects with a 302 back to /login but the session has changed so no @error/withErrors bag reaches the re-rendered view. Workaround: clear cookies before each login. Fix: ensure LoginController/Blade renders the generic 'silaken coba lagi' message when @error('email') is empty but session has expired; alternatively return 419 error page instead of silent 302.
